title: Social entrepreneur and goodbyes
summary: They discuss the label 'cultural' or 'social entrepreneur' and thank each other to end the interview.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well this has been fascinating, once again. And I wish you the best of luck with your concert on Friday, and as a pianist and composer and thinker — and I think you called yourself a “cultural entrepreneur?”
Yeah, Steve Yao did. Professor Steve Yao.
I said “social entrepreneur.” Yeah that is, well one way to define it that is one who engages in a process that solves social problems with innovative solutions.
And we do it through music and though I guess being a public intellectual — or multiple ways. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -18-
Right. Well thanks for your time again.
Well thank you, Monk. © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -19-
